caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a rounded, ornate backrest and four curved legs. The wood is colored in varying shades of brown, highlighting the structure and decorative details of the frame. The seat is upholstered with a patterned fabric featuring floral designs in muted colors, including green, yellow, white, and hints of pink and gray. The composition centers the chair against a plain, light beige background, and there is a thin, double-lined rectangular border surrounding the entire image. No other objects or elements appear in the drawing.
title: Chair
